confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors draw on a few current-typical price ranges from travel and cost-of-living sources, and the Swiss franc-to-USD conversion is my own assumption, so they are approximate. The sources were mixed: one budget guide gave a draft beer near USD 5.63, while 2026 guides cite CHF 6-8 for beer, and I used the higher range. No cocktail price was found in the searches, so cocktail is inferred from the beer relationship (roughly 2.5 to 3 times a draft beer in Swiss resort bars). Meal anchors reflect Swiss restaurant and Migros/Coop-style ranges. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of July peak-season alpine resort pricing; I did not check live booking pages or current listings. Interlaken is a high-cost Swiss resort town, and July is peak season, so accommodation is the least certain set.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other Swiss alpine resort towns (for example Lauterbrunnen, Grindelwald, Lucerne), with Swiss price levels for food and drink and European Alpine-resort tourist pricing for accommodation in July.
